note: An [[errata.column]] mint on a documented_blank matrix answer's column (#1681). The step-1 source gains an earlier CIS wave, edition '2010 - 2012' (regver 7292, one documented column ORG). The CO12 mint names the matrix's own edition '2012 - 2014', so answer-abroad and the mint would both claim CO12 in that one delivery: the mint is refused as a stale entry whose detail names the matrix answer, and forms no c-co12 state. The CO11 mint names '2010 - 2012', the adjacent wave, which shares the reference year 2012 with the matrix edition, as committed CIS2002 mints share 2002 with the cis2004 matrix: two deliveries, so it mints c-co11 beside answer-sweden.
fails_if: `compile_errata` in curation_compile.py does not refuse an [[errata.column]] mint on a column a documented_blank matrix answer adds in the same variant and edition (a c-co12 state is built, no stale issue), or the refusal compares dates rather than editions (the c-co11 mint on the adjacent wave is refused), or the detail stops naming the matrix answer

sources.description: SCB register 257 (variant 553): the step-1 blank-column CIS 2014 instance plus an earlier wave '2010 - 2012' documenting ORG.
